<thought>Based on the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.1154, which corresponds to a protonated molecule [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈140.1081 Da. The formula C₇H₁₂N₂O matches this mass most closely (theoretical neutral mass 140.09496 Da, within typical high‑resolution error), so the molecular formula is C₇H₁₂N₂O.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12N2O</final_answer>
